appearance.extreme: They're hided over in dark thorn-bark from the jaw down, grained and split and hard, and where it creases at the joints there are short blunt spines.
appearance.obvious: Their skin has gone dark and barked over the forearms and the back of the neck, split into small hard plates like a thorn stem.
appearance.subtle: The backs of their hands are darker than the rest of them, and rough.

description: The hide the Pool gives everyone. Dark, barked skin that turns a blade and marks you as theirs, which is the half that matters.
drawbacks: Everyone in the city can see what you're now
name: Thornhide
